lines.en: I sob as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，呼吸很重
lines.en: My steps are light; my breathing is heavy.
I feel along the corridor wall.

lines.zh: 眼泪掉在地上，没有声音
lines.en: Tears fall to the floor without a sound.
Every few steps I stop and gasp.

lines.zh: 我在找一个人，谁都可以
lines.en: I'm looking for someone. Anyone.
My fingers rake the wallpaper.
The corridor is too long. I can't finish it.

lines.zh: 我低着头，肩膀一抽一抽
lines.en: Head down, my shoulders jerk with sobs.
I pass a door and don't go in.
The lamp lights me and I'm still crying.
I stop at every step, as if waiting.
I crouch in the corner, very quiet.
I bury my face in my hands.
I keep asking if anyone's there.
My crying pauses for a moment.
Then it starts again.
It really does hurt.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出来，又缩回去
lines.en: I reach out a hand, then pull it back.
The floor is cold. I don't care.
I listen for an answer.
Nothing. Still no one.
My breathing shakes badly.
I look up toward the door.
I don't want to stand up now.
Are you leaving? Please don't.
You came. You finally came.
Please. Don't leave me here.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，你看见了吗
lines.en: My hands are shaking. Do you see?
I look up, my face all wet.
Could you help me up?
I don't want to be alone here.
I hurt. I can't say where.
Say something. Anything.
I know I look awful.
But I can't help it.
Don't stand in the doorway. Come in.

lines.zh: 你一走，我就又一个人了
lines.en: If you leave, I'm alone again.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步就停了哭
lines.en: I stopped crying when I heard your steps.
Don't be afraid. I'm not fierce.
I only want someone here.
You're reaching out. Thank you.
A little closer. I can't see well.
How is your hand so warm?
Don't let go. Please.
No one has touched me in so long.
Don't look—my face is running.
You've made the pain worse.
I'm crying too hard to speak.
I shrink back into the wall.
Crying, and my hands are up.
Why are you like the others?
I look up at you with wet eyes.
I can't catch my breath at all.
Stop hitting me. Please.
I did nothing, truly.

lines.zh: 我一边摸墙走，一边抽泣。
lines.en: I weep as I feel my way along the wall.
Is that for me? Really?
I'm not hungry. I just want it.

lines.zh: 你放在地上就好，我哭完再拿。
lines.en: Just leave it on the ground; I will take it when done crying.
Thank you. I'll hold it.

lines.zh: 有人给我东西，好久没有
lines.en: No one's given me anything in ages.
I'm crying too hard to see it.
Don't take it back like that.
I'll keep this with me always.
You really are a gentle person.
You touch me and I flinch.

lines.zh: 对不起，我不是故意撞你
lines.en: Sorry. I didn't mean to bump you.
I hold the wall and steady.
Your hand steadies my shoulder.
I pull back so I don't dirty you.
That made me cry harder.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你的背，你抖了。
lines.en: My hand passes through your back; you shudder.
Are you trembling, or am I?
We bumped. I'm cold.
You're still here. That's good.
You won't leave, will you?

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子就好了
lines.en: I'll just hold your sleeve.
Don't watch me cry. It's ugly.
Stay, and I'll stop crying.
I'm afraid of the dark. Truly.
You sit, and I'll be right beside you.
I'm hard to understand, aren't I?
But I keep talking.
Don't find me too talkative.
When it's light, will you still be here?

lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，抱在怀里
lines.en: I pick it up and hold it to my chest.
May I keep this?
You dropped it. Here.
My hands shook. I dropped it twice.
It's cold, like the floor.
I put it in my pocket.
What someone gives me, I don't throw away.
I'm slow. Wait for me.
I could sleep holding this.
Thank you for dropping it here.
Did you hear me crying?
Turn around. Look at me.
Don't go. I'm begging you.
I stand; my legs shake.
I can't catch you, but I'll try.
Running makes the pain worse.
I run and cry at the same time.
Why does everyone leave?
If I could just catch you.
Stop. Just for a moment.
I don't want it to be like last time.
I touched the back of your neck.
Don't scream. I don't like screaming.
Let me catch you and it won't hurt.

lines.zh: 哭出来的声音，是我的名字。
lines.en: The sound of crying is my name.

lines.zh: 你听见了吗，我又在哭了
lines.en: Do you hear? I'm crying again.
I follow the sound of you.
You're behind the cabinet.

lines.zh: 你屏住气的样子，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear how you hold your breath.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，一点点挪近
lines.en: Dragging my feet, I inch nearer.
Don't hold your breath. I can tell.
My hands feel along the wall.
There's nowhere to hide in this room.
I sat at the door a while.
I know you're still in there.
I'm crying again. Sorry.
Don't tire of me. I only want—
Only to have someone nearby.

lines.zh: 你听得见我的指甲声吗
lines.en: Can you hear my nails?
That's me finding the handle.
This lock isn't very strong.
I'm coming in. Don't be afraid.
I only want to sit down.
I want to sit beside you.
That should be all right, yes?
Don't move. I'm coming over.
I've got hold of your wrist.
Sorry. I'm holding too tight.
I just want to lean for a while.
Don't pull. I won't let go.
I lean my whole weight on you.
You're warm. I don't want to let go.
Crying, I hold on tighter.

lines.zh: 我的指甲只是划破了皮。
lines.en: My nails only broke the skin.
Don't leave either. All right?
I don't want to be alone again.
Your hands are on my back.
Then stay a little longer.
I'll let go when I count to ten.
One, two — I'm counting.
Don't lose count now.
I feel better. Really.

lines.zh: 你听见哭声了吗，从那边
lines.en: Did you hear crying? From over there.
I'm sitting on the corridor floor.

lines.zh: 灯管闪了两下，我还在哭
lines.en: The tube flickered twice; I'm still crying.
Is anyone there? Anyone?

lines.zh: 我的脸上分不清泪和水
lines.en: On my face I can't tell tears from water.

lines.zh: 我从房间那头慢慢挪过来
lines.en: I inch over from the far side of the room.
Please, someone help me.

lines.zh: 这间屋子以前不是这样的
lines.en: This room didn't use to be like this.
I've been waiting for someone to come in.
You're here. Don't turn off the light.
I fear the dark, and the quiet.
It's hurting again.
I am weeping, and waiting for you.
I mean no harm. Truly none.

lines.zh: 你坐一会儿吧，就一会儿
lines.en: Sit a while. Just a while.
I press my face into my knees.

lines.zh: 你别走开，我不动就是了
lines.en: Don't walk away. I won't move, I promise.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声让我好受一点
lines.en: Your footsteps make it easier.
I heard the door.
Please. Don't leave me alone.
The fire nears and my crying goes shrill.
I fall down the stairs and roll to the bottom.

lines.zh: 水进了喉咙，我喊不出来
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I can't cry out.
The blast throws me into the corner.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我肩上，我抖了一下
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder makes me jerk.
That light shuts my eyes.
Too starved to cry aloud.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整个人缩起来
lines.en: At the thunder I curl up entirely.
There's nothing around me anymore.
